snippet.title: Kristala – Official Full Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
A curse spreads across the world of Ailur.

Rise as an elite feline warrior.
Master the power of the Sacred Kristals.
Complete the Raksaka Proving.
Uncover the truth buried in shadow.

Kristala launches April 23, 2026 on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.

Wishlist now on Steam and Epic Games Store.
Play the free demo today on PlayStation and Xbox.

#Kristala #Soulslike #ActionRPG #DarkFantasy
